**problem**
"V11 Business Logic Security Requirements" is the only category with requirement numbers formated to X.X (not X.X.X like others)

**recommendation**
  * "Rename" subcategory "V11 Business Logic Security Requirements" to "**V11.1** Business Logic Security Requirements"
  * Fix requirement numbers from X.X to X.X.X
title: V11 - make requirement number format like other categories (3 levels)
